items.title: Apple just released a weirdly interesting coding language model
items.raw_content: Apple has just released an AI model that, rather than generating code from left to right, does it out of order and all at once. Here's how.
items.title_zh: 苹果发布了一款颇为有趣的代码语言模型
items.summary: Apple has released an AI model that generates code out of order and all at once, rather than from left to right.

items.title: Huawei releases an open weight model trained on Huawei Ascend GPUs
items.raw_content: The surgence of Mixture of Experts (MoE) in Large Language Models promises a small price of execution cost for a much larger model parameter count and learning capacity, because only a small fraction of parameters are activated for each input token. However, it is commonly observed that some experts are activated far more often than others, leading to system inefficiency when running the experts on different devices in parallel. Therefore, we introduce Mixture of Grouped Experts (MoGE), which groups the experts during selection and balances the expert workload better than MoE in nature. It constrains tokens to activate an equal number of experts within each predefined expert group. When a model execution is distributed on multiple devices, this architectural design ensures a balanced computational load across devices, significantly enhancing throughput, particularly for the inference pha
items.title_zh: 华为发布基于昇腾 GPU 训练的开源权重模型
items.summary: The paper describes Mixture of Grouped Experts (MoGE), an architecture that groups experts before selection and requires every token to activate the same number of experts inside each predefined group. According to the authors, this keeps workloads balanced when a model runs across multiple devices and raises throughput, especially during inference.

items.title: Rethinking the Illusion of Thinking
items.title_zh: 重新思考「思考的错觉」
items.summary: The paper replicates and refines two benchmarks from Apple's 'The Illusion of Thinking' study, finding that large reasoning models' Towers of Hanoi failures partly reflect cognitive limits, while their apparent River Crossing failures came from testing unsolvable configurations.

items.title: Compressing Deep Neural Networks Using Explainable AI
items.title_zh: 利用可解释 AI 压缩深度神经网络
items.summary: A compression approach derives weight-importance scores with Layer-wise Relevance Propagation, prunes weights with zero or negative scores and applies mixed-precision quantization; it reports a 64% smaller model and 42% higher accuracy than a state-of-the-art XAI-based compression method.

items.title: Efficient Triple Modular Redundancy for Reliability Enhancement of DNNs Using Explainable AI
items.title_zh: 利用可解释 AI 的高效三模冗余提升 DNN 可靠性
items.summary: The paper uses Layer-wise Relevance Propagation, a low-cost gradient-based explainable-AI technique, to score parameter importance so triple modular redundancy protects only the most critical weights; on AlexNet at a bit error rate of 10^-4 it reports more than 60% reliability improvement at the same overhead as state-of-the-art methods.

items.title: A Weakly Supervised Transformer for Rare Disease Diagnosis and Subphenotyping from EHRs with Pulmonary Case Studies
items.title_zh: 一种用于电子病历罕见病诊断与亚型分型的弱监督 Transformer
items.summary: The authors propose WEST, a weakly supervised transformer that combines routinely collected EHR data with a limited set of expert-validated cases to phenotype rare diseases, evaluated on two rare pulmonary diseases using data from Boston Children's Hospital.

items.title: Do Role-Playing Agents Practice What They Preach? Belief-Behavior Consistency in LLM-Based Simulations of Human Trust
items.title_zh: 角色扮演智能体是否言行一致？LLM 人类信任模拟中的信念与行为一致性
items.summary: The paper introduces a framework to measure whether the beliefs LLM-based role-playing agents state about the people they simulate predict their actual behavior in a Trust Game simulation. Using an augmented GenAgents persona bank, it finds systematic inconsistencies between stated or imposed beliefs and simulation outcomes at both individual and population levels.

items.title: SI-Agent: An Agentic Framework for Feedback-Driven Generation and Tuning of Human-Readable System Instructions for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: SI-Agent：自动生成并调优人类可读系统指令的智能体框架
items.summary: SI-Agent is an agentic framework with three collaborating agents — an Instructor, an Instruction Follower (the target LLM) and a Feedback/Reward agent — that generates and iteratively refines human-readable system instructions in a feedback loop, reported to offer a favorable trade-off between performance and interpretability.

items.title: Cloud Digital Forensic Readiness: An Open Source Approach to Law Enforcement Request Management
items.title_zh: 云数字取证就绪：以开源方式管理执法请求
items.summary: The paper reviews major cloud providers' transparency reports and law-enforcement guidelines, then proposes CLERMS, an architecture built on open-source components for managing law-enforcement requests, validated through two scenarios with a cost estimate.

items.title: Nile-Chat: Egyptian Language Models for Arabic and Latin Scripts
items.title_zh: Nile-Chat：支持阿拉伯字母和拉丁字母的埃及方言语言模型
items.summary: The authors introduce Nile-Chat-4B, Nile-Chat-3x4B-A6B and Nile-Chat-12B, LLMs for Egyptian dialect that read and generate both Arabic and Latin scripts; they report gains over leading multilingual and Arabic models on new Egyptian benchmarks, including a 14.4% improvement for the 12B model over Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on Latin-script benchmarks.
